files_metadata_check.name: files_metadata_check
files_metadata_check.value: "files"."status" <> 'ready' OR ("files"."media_type" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."media_type" IN ('image/png','image/jpeg','image/webp','application/json') AND "files"."byte_size" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."byte_size" > 0 AND "files"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

ia_items_names_check.name: ia_items_names_check
ia_items_names_check.value: char_length(btrim("ia_items"."screen_id")) > 0 AND "ia_items"."screen_id" = btrim("ia_items"."screen_id") AND char_length(btrim("ia_items"."name")) > 0 AND "ia_items"."name" = btrim("ia_items"."name")

test_scenario_columns_kind_check.name: test_scenario_columns_kind_check
test_scenario_columns_kind_check.value: ("test_scenario_columns"."kind" = 'system' AND "test_scenario_columns"."field" IS NOT NULL AND "test_scenario_columns"."field" IN ('caseCode','title') AND "test_scenario_columns"."value_type" IS NULL) OR ("test_scenario_columns"."kind" = 'custom' AND "test_scenario_columns"."field" IS NULL AND "test_scenario_columns"."value_type" IS NOT NULL AND "test_scenario_columns"."value_type" IN ('text','select','checkbox','tags'))
